plain: Brent Friedman, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he heard through his mother that a man named Harrington had been involved in ABSCAM, a US federal sting operation into political corruption around 1980 and 1981 in Washington, DC. He tells it as part of explaining who this man was and how serious his government background was.
